items.text: At Hopedale Medical Complex today, I visited with healthcare workers, doctors, and administrators who continue to support Tazewell County and the surrounding communities. Rural health workforce shortages have put added stress on hospitals amid COVID-19. https://t.co/aCl3LXhYfD

I am grateful to Hopedale’s workforce for their commitment to patients despite the challenges of the last year. I will continue to support Illinois’ rural health facilities and nurse training to help stem healthcare workforce shortages that are challenging our health system.

Thanks to the Illinois Association of Nurse Anesthetists and CRNAs from the 18th District for meeting with me in DC this week to discuss policy issues impacting their profession. I am grateful to the CRNAs in Illinois that continue to support and serve patients. https://t.co/8D2E6w1Ifx

I stopped by the OSF Healthcare Cancer Institute construction this morning to sign the final beam before it is put into place. The Cancer Institute will offer patients cutting edge treatments and therapies in Peoria. Thanks to the OSF team for investing in central Illinois! https://t.co/SwdBcauOqE

I visited Rock Steady Boxing in Peoria Heights to learn about their boxing programs for Parkinson’s patients, especially vets. In Congress, I am proud to support these programs, which is why I introduced the Boxing Therapy for Parkinson’s Act to support access to boxing therapy. https://t.co/TMOYVsD5C1

I had a great tour of the Morris YMCA with their leadership team and enjoyed seeing their plans to expand the facility. The YMCA is an important resource for Grundy County residents and their partnership with Morris Hospital & Healthcare Centers is valued by all in the community. https://t.co/h2WRRyuBXP

I’ve introduced a bipartisan bill to support families across the country dealing with Alzheimer’s disease. Our bill will support innovation for Alzheimer’s treatment and help patients, families, and caregivers through greater coordination of care. #ENDALZ https://t.co/irF6vEieJw

I met with Daniel Mennenoh and Mary Schuster, professionals in land title and property insurance from Galena. We discussed housing issues in northwestern Illinois, rural broadband access in the region, and protecting property rights. 

Thanks for stopping by! https://t.co/U2BAyMnRo7

I started my day at the Illinois Cancer Care facility in Peoria, visiting with staff and touring the facility. Illinois Cancer Care serves over 20,000 patients each year and I am grateful for their important work to care for individuals with cancer. https://t.co/PccLvJtmrS

In Rockford this morning, I toured the the Rock River Valley Blood Center. The RRVBC provides critical blood services to patients in need throughout northwestern Illinois. Blood donations can help save lives, and I am grateful for all the work RRVBC does in the community. https://t.co/KDlqMBctG6

Enjoyed spending some time with the Winnebago/Boone County Farm Bureau this week to hear about their priorities for the upcoming Farm Bill. Whether it’s E-15 year-round, crop insurance, labor issues, or trade policy, I will continue to advocate for our ag community in #IL16. https://t.co/9UuSTq4bLp

In Elmwood, we announced federal funding and unveiled plans for the new Elmwood Rural Health and Wellness Center with Graham Medical Group and the YMCA. My office was proud to help secure Community Project Funding for the center, which will support better health outcomes and physical activity in our rural communities.

FDA approval of treatment targeting the early stages of Alzheimer’s and broader CMS coverage is an important step in the fight to end Alzheimer’s.

I will continue to advocate for policies that enhance innovation of cures, ensure robust access to care, and support caregivers. https://t.co/xecpvxl3pm

#IL16 is one of the largest ag producing districts in the country. I visited with the @ILFarmBureau during their visit to DC to discuss the 2023 Farm Bill, enhancement of crop insurance, biofuels, and trade. 

Thanks for stopping by! https://t.co/1LJYo6hG4F

I visited @OSFHealthCare this morning for a hard hat tour of the Cancer Institute in Peoria. The new Cancer Institute will make OSF in Peoria a hub for cancer research & treatment, supporting patients from across the state & country. Thank you to State Rep. Ryan Spain, former Peoria Mayor Jim Ardis, and Ryan Luginbuhl for hosting us. I appreciate OSF’s hard work to serve the community and #BringHopeHome.

The @WaysandMeansGOP passed my Health Savings for Families Act of 2023, legislation that would allow individuals to maintain a HSA even if the individual’s spouse is enrolled in a FSA. This will allow patients to have more choice and control of their own health care dollars. https://t.co/Xj6bMCHqjX

I started my day with a visit to Heartland Health Services in Pekin to meet their staff and tour the facility. Heartland Health Services works hard to serve the community and provide care to families across the tri-county region. Thank you for all that you do for Tazewell County. https://t.co/Vc7a7ShkB8

Proud to join @RepAdrianSmith and a bipartisan group to introduce the Keep Physicians Serving Patients Act. Ensuring Medicare providers in rural areas are not unfairly impacted from lower payments based on an outdated model is critical for access to care. https://t.co/2IKqJfFeEp

Thank you to Dave and Kelly at Rosecrance for hosting us in Rockford for a tour. I appreciate the work Rosecrance does to support families in our community get the behavioral health treatment they need.
Happy New Year! I hope your 2024 is blessed with happiness and good health. 🎉 https://t.co/JvuAZt2Cuw

Thank you to Dwayne Anderson and Jim Martin from @ILSoybean for stopping by this week in DC. I appreciate their advocacy for #IL16 farmers and I will continue to work with our producers to strengthen our inland waterways system, crop insurance, and trade markets. https://t.co/XGyWj8ak30

I joined State Senator Dave Syverson and Harvard Mayor Mike Kelly this afternoon for a visit to the U.S. Medical Glove Plant. I appreciated the opportunity to tour their facility, learn about their business, and discuss the important work they do in sustainable engineering and machine manufacturing.

In rural communities, timely access to life-saving medications is essential to safeguarding patient health. At our @WaysandMeansGOP hearing, I discussed the challenges rural communities face to access drugs and the need to reduce our reliance on foreign drug manufacturers. https://t.co/0DcYbqeEUN

Thank you to the National Bleeding Disorders Foundation, including Becky Burns and Matt McLain from BCDI in Peoria, for visiting this week in DC.

During National Bleeding Disorders Awareness Month, I appreciated the chance to discuss challenges facing hemophilia patients and improving treatments.

The Protecting Access to Ground Ambulance Medical Services Act will preserve access to critical 9-1-1 and ambulance services in rural communities in #IL16. As a member of the EMS Caucus, I will continue to support our life-saving emergency service providers. 

Glad to see this important bill pass out of @WaysandMeansGOP today.
